task: AG-05 Targeted Safety Boundaries & Launch Identity Negative Verification

assertions.test: Test 1: authorized_keys backup failure blocks deployment before changes
assertions.details: Removed '|| true' on backup command; verified content with cmp -s; simulated backup disk failure; production-entry.sh deploy aborted with exit 1 before candidate compose file copy or watchdog spawn; zero mutation occurred.

assertions.test: Test 2: Target user home/.ssh exists but sshd config unresolvable: refused deploy
assertions.details: Deleted fallback guessing branch from production-entry.sh; configured environment where target user's home/.ssh/authorized_keys exists, but sshd -T resolution fails and SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS_PATH is unset; deployment strictly rejected with exit 1 without reading, copying, or touching guessed user home path.

assertions.test: Test 3: Docker inspect fail / empty / unknown strictly blocks restore
assertions.details: Defaulted container_stopped=0; tested Subcase 3a (inspect command failure), Subcase 3b (empty inspection string), and Subcase 3c (status 'unknown'); all 3 subcases engaged [SAFETY_BARRIER], strictly skipped rsync configuration overwrite and docker compose up, and exited 1.

assertions.test: Test 4: Same UID/name with missing or mismatched identity record: refuses signal
assertions.details: Spawned background process with matching name ('EventKitBridgeServer') and same UID; in Subcase 4A (missing bridge_identity.env), tunnel-ctl refused to signal and exited 1; in Subcase 4B (mismatched launch identity timestamp/config), tunnel-ctl refused to signal and exited 1; unrelated process remained completely unharmed in both cases.

assertions.test: Test 5: PID/UID/config/deadline matched but launch identity mismatched: refuses reuse
assertions.details: Configured watchdog_metadata.env where PID, UID, CONFIG_DIR, and DEADLINE_EPOCH all matched current task, but WATCHDOG_LSTART differed from dummy process launch timestamp; run-resident-tunnel.sh detected launch identity mismatch, refused to reuse unverified watchdog, did not signal dummy process, and spawned a fresh verified watchdog.
